claim_boundary.benchmark: Public LAB Contracts tasks and public criteria; not an official Harvey private leaderboard result.
claim_boundary.stress: LAB-derived controlled handoff stress test; not an official Harvey benchmark result.
claim_boundary.uncertainty: Descriptive paired repeated-run uncertainty on a fixed task panel; not a population estimate.
claim_boundary.invalid: Invalid attempts are retained but excluded from treatment estimates.
